predecessors.name: Hoysala Kingdom
predecessors.text: the enclave round Kammata Durga near Ballari that Singeya Nayaka III held as a Hoysala commander

successors.name: Tughlaq dynasty
successors.text: 'The Kampili kingdom then fell to the invasion in 1327 CE from the north' to Muhammad bin Tughluq's forces

successors.name: Vijayanagara Empire
successors.text: 'The Vijayanagara Empire emerged in 1336 CE from the remains of this kingdom'

ledger.x: 1285: Kampili appears at Kammata Durga on the Tungabhadra.
1327: Kampili falls to Muhammad bin Tughluq.

wars.name: Tughlaq conquest of Kampili
wars.outcome: Kampili destroyed; Kampilideva killed and his head sent to Delhi; the land becomes Tughlaq territory.

certainty.note: A district of about 5,000 km2 round one fort; the page gives no boundary.
